title: Potential energy becomes kinetic energy
caption: As the ball falls, every joule of gravitational potential energy lost becomes kinetic energy, so the total stays at mgh = 98 J. At the ground all 98 J is kinetic: v = √(2gh) = 19.8 m s⁻¹.
alt: Energy against distance fallen: potential energy falling from 98 joules to zero, kinetic energy rising from zero to 98, and total energy a flat line at 98.
description: Potential energy falls in a straight line with distance fallen; kinetic energy rises by the same amount.
They cross at 10 m, where each is 49 J.
At the ground: ½mv² = 98 J, v = 19.8 m s⁻¹.
